items.title: Josephine Davies interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 14, 2025
items.q: There’s a harpist called Maria-Christina Harper oddly enough. She’s a Greek musician. And we started playing together about four years ago and we have a trio with me on saxophone and a drummer.

ctx.x: What’s up for you next? Do you find that you need to shift from project to project depending on the availability of the people you play with?

Yeah. Actually up next is something I’m – it is a collaboration but it’s under the harp player’s name. There’s a harpist called Maria-Christina Harper oddly enough. She’s a Greek musician. And we started playing together about four years ago and we have a trio with me on saxophone and a drummer. And the drummer is in a couple of bands that are on tour a lot. So actually the next project I’m doing is we have an album release at the end of this month so we’re doing a tour, just around the U.K. for now, although we…
Yeah, and as you said, you mentioned the one drummer that was playing on “Insomnia” I guess and that they brought something to the table that someone else might not have.
